ReportTheme: Theme 4: Dense-Breast Fairness & Resolution/Architecture-vs-Loss Tradeoffs Under Causal XAI
Statement: Dense tissue (BI-RADS C/D: 89.96% VinDr, 89.1% Taizhou) degrades lesion AUC (-0.057 in P0033) and chance-normalized Grad-CAM localization (-37.3 pp on dense masses), while DAF loss hurts AUC and doubles ECE (P0034); meanwhile 224x224 downsampling cripples CAM/ViT localization (P0016, P0385) vs rectangular/higher-res hybrids (P1030), yet no study evaluates subgroup density fairness across calibrated CNN vs hybrid/ViT architectures with XAI faithfulness.
SearchCoverage: 48 T05 extractions across Q1-Q4 query families including Stage-2 OA P0385, P0810, P1030, P1433
Q1SaturationVerdict: UNSATURATED_Q1_ABLATION_AND_FAIRNESS_GAP: Controlled resolution/architecture/CLAHE/imbalance effects on calibrated BI-RADS A-D accuracy and XAI faithfulness remain untested
Feasibility: High (controlled single-variable ablations under fixed splits/seeds; subgroup breakdown over VinDr/CBIS/INbreast BI-RADS density tags)
